card_1_skill1_desc: Choose an allied card and grant it 10 Armor and -2% damage taken for 2 turns.
card_1_skill2_desc: Stares down a target, dealing 5 DMG. Increases their damage taken by 5% for 2 turns and stuns them for 1 turn.
card_1_passive_desc: When an allied card is destroyed, grants +5 Armor to all allies and stuns a random enemy card for 1 turn.
card_1_lore: They say those lucky enough to gaze upon this eye eventually go mad and take their own lives. No one truly knows where it comes from — illusion or genuine summoning — but people call it the Eye of the Ancients.
card_1_quote: A single glance changes your destiny.
card_2_skill1_desc: Attacks a target for 15 DMG. Heals for the full amount of damage dealt.
card_2_skill2_desc: Charges a target for 12 DMG. Adjacent cards take 50% of total damage. Stuns all targets for 1 turn.
card_2_lore: This creature belongs to a dimension only the most skilled Black Mages can invoke. Should this species ever find the ability to materialize in our world on its own, chaos would follow, and a terrible fate would await us in return.
card_3_skill1_desc: Engulfs all enemy cards, dealing 15 DMG instantly and applying Burn for 2 turns (10% max HP).
card_3_skill2_desc: Enters a Murderous Rage, increasing both damage dealt and taken by 5% for 2 turns.
card_3_passive_desc: If this card destroys an enemy card, heals for 10% of its max HP and increases damage dealt by 5% for 2 turns.
card_3_lore: The Flame Behemoth is one of the most feared creatures in the world. Crossing its path means dying on the spot — once it chooses its prey, the Behemoth hunts it relentlessly until death claims one of them.
card_3_quote: Death is the only outcome of our meeting.
card_4_skill1_desc: Charges a target for 22 DMG and 50% to adjacent cards. Applies Burn (10% max HP) for 2 turns.
card_4_skill2_desc: Applies a Major Burn (20% max HP) to a target for 2 turns. If the target is already Burning, deals 10 additional DMG.
card_4_passive_desc: For each allied Fire card, Wolfgorn gains 2% bonus damage and 1% damage reduction.
card_4_lore: Wolfgorn was above all a Pyromancer. He belonged to a renowned mercenary group, recognized by many as among the finest Pyromancers. During a mission, a witch cursed him into a werewolf, and he slaughtered his entire team. Since then, he wanders alone across the lands, assaulting any unfortunate adventurer he encounters.
card_4_quote: Play with Fire long enough, and you become the Flame.
card_5_skill1_desc: Stuns a target for 1 turn. They also take 10% additional damage for 2 turns.
card_5_skill2_desc: Attacks a target for 5 DMG and grants 5 Armor to a random ally and 3 Armor to itself.
card_5_passive_desc: Each time an allied card is destroyed, grants 5 Armor to all allies and reduces their damage taken by 5% for 2 turns.
card_5_lore: Gekkous is a reptilian who has lived through atrocious experiences. One of them allowed him to speak basic Common, enabling him to converse and make friends, whom he considers his own family.
card_6_skill1_desc: Dives at the target and tears into it, dealing 12 DMG and increasing their damage taken by 10% for 2 turns.
card_6_skill2_desc: Dives brutally onto a target, dealing 18 DMG while ignoring Armor.
card_6_lore: The Dawn Griffin is a creature trained and bred for combat by the Aurores. They are often ridden by soldiers, but can sometimes fight alone without a rider, making them more lethal than ever. They say a single Scratch can end a life faster than an arrow to the heart.
card_7_skill1_desc: Deals 12 DMG and makes the target Bleed, losing 5% max HP per turn for 3 turns. If the target is at 50% HP or below, deals 15% additional damage.
card_7_skill2_desc: Sharpens his blade, increasing damage dealt by 15% for 3 turns. Reduces damage taken by 10% for 1 turn.
card_7_passive_desc: As long as this card does not attack, it becomes Invisible and cannot be targeted by direct skills. If this card attacks during its turn, it loses Invisibility until the next turn.
card_7_lore: Istan was a man of great skill and value — until the day his wife was brutally murdered by a group called "Blood Moon". Since then, Istan has become an Assassin, relentlessly hunting every man and woman bearing that group's insignia, driven by pain and hatred.
card_7_quote: You stole her life. I will take yours.
card_8_skill1_desc: Deals 15 DMG to a target and Burns them for 1 turn (10% max HP). If the target is already Burning, deals 25% additional damage.
card_8_skill2_desc: Deals 12 DMG to all enemies and Burns them for 2 turns (10% max HP).
card_8_lore: The Fire Dragon is the eldest of the elemental drakes. Born in the crater of the Kael'ar volcano, it is the living embodiment of creative destruction. Civilizations that faced it are gone. Those that learned to respect it prospered — for a time.
card_8_quote: I don't need a reason to burn.
card_9_skill1_desc: Deals 15 DMG. The lightning bolt spreads to adjacent targets (40% of damage).
card_9_skill2_desc: Deals 10 DMG to all enemy cards and stuns a random enemy for 1 turn.
card_9_lore: No one knows where Thunder Dragons are born. They appear in storms and vanish with them. Some believe they are the storms themselves, given form for a fleeting moment.
card_9_quote: I am not in the storm. I am the storm.
card_10_skill1_desc: Deals 22 DMG to a target. Ignores the target's Armor.
card_10_skill2_desc: +5 Armor and +5% damage dealt for 3 turns. If the target is below 50% HP, reduces their damage taken by 10% for 2 turns.
card_10_lore: The Earth Dragon does not move — it moves the earth around it. Each step it takes cracks the ground beneath. Patient as a mountain, relentless as a glacier, and just as impossible to stop.
card_10_quote: Stone does not bend. It crushes.
card_11_skill1_desc: Deals 13 DMG and increases the target's active cooldown by 1 turn.
card_11_skill2_desc: Deals 10 DMG to all enemy cards. Increases their damage taken by 5% for 2 turns.
card_11_lore: The Water Dragon has dwelled in the depths of the Silent Ocean for millennia. It only surfaces when it senses an imbalance in the elements. Its presence always foretells a storm — literally and figuratively.
card_11_quote: The ocean has memory. And it never forgets.
card_12_skill1_desc: Deals 20 DMG to a target and heals for 10% of damage dealt. If the target is Poisoned, deals 10% additional damage.
card_12_skill2_desc: Deals 12 DMG to all enemy cards and increases their damage taken by 5% for 2 turns.
card_12_lore: The Shadow Dragon is the only dragon that leaves no trace. No footprints, no ashes, no witnesses. Historians still debate its existence — but the few survivors of its attacks no longer debate anything.
card_12_quote: What you cannot see kills you better.
card_13_skill1_desc: Deals 23 DMG to a target while ignoring Armor. If this card is below 50% HP, gains a 5% Heal over Time for 2 turns.
card_13_skill2_desc: Heals all allies for 15% of their max HP. If this card is below 30% HP, heals itself for an additional 5%.
card_13_lore: The Light Dragon does not attack — it judges. It scrutinizes every opponent with its golden eyes and decides whether their presence on the battlefield is deserved. Most of the time, its verdict is no.
card_13_quote: Light has no enemy. Only absences.
card_14_skill1_desc: Deals 35 DMG to a target while ignoring Armor.
card_14_skill2_desc: Deals 45 DMG to a target and 50% to adjacent cards. Renders all hit targets unable to be healed for 2 turns.
card_14_passive_desc: When any element reaches 5 stacks, Nyolung applies 8 DMG per turn to all enemies. In return, allied cards take 5% additional damage.
card_14_lore: Nyolung belongs to no element. It has absorbed them all, digested them all, transcended them all. Other dragons respect it. Elementals fear it. It is the eldest — not because it is the oldest, but because it is what all dragons aspire to become.
card_14_quote: I do not choose my element. I am all the elements.
card_15_skill1_desc: Deals 30 DMG to a target while ignoring Armor.
card_15_skill2_desc: Deals 50 DMG to a target and 50% to adjacent cards. Heals all allies for 5% max HP. If this card is below 30% HP, deals 15% additional damage and heals itself for 5% max HP.
card_15_passive_desc: For each Light ally destroyed, applies a Heal over Time (2% max HP for 2 turns) to all remaining allies.
card_15_lore: Ilidius is not an angel — he is the verdict. Before each battle, he silently evaluates his opponents. Those who acted out of fear or coercion, he spares. Those who chose evil of their own free will, he judges. He has never given a lenient verdict twice in a row.
card_15_quote: The sky does not forgive. It waits.
card_16_skill1_desc: Deals 30 DMG to a target and renders them unable to be healed for 1 turn. If the target is Poisoned, deals 10% additional damage.
card_16_skill2_desc: Deals 25 DMG to all enemy cards. Heals itself for 10% max HP over 2 turns.
card_16_passive_desc: If this card destroys a card, heals for 15% of its max HP.
card_16_lore: Dénotrus was once a knight of light. One of the greatest. Then he stared into the abyss to defeat what he fought — and the abyss stared back. He still wears his armor, but it is black as night. He remembers what he was. It changes nothing.
card_16_quote: I chose power. Power chose me in return.
card_17_skill1_desc: Deals 12 DMG to a target and Burns them (10% max HP) for 2 turns.
card_17_skill2_desc: Deals 20 DMG to a target and all adjacent cards. Burns them all (10% max HP) for 2 turns.
card_17_lore: The Fire Elemental is not a creature — it is a will. A flame so ancient it has developed a consciousness, so burning it has forgotten what it means to be cold. It does not fight out of hatred. It fights because it is its nature: to consume.
card_17_quote: I do not burn. I am the burning.
card_18_skill1_desc: Deals 10 DMG to a target and increases their cooldown by 1 turn.
card_18_skill2_desc: Increases all enemy cards' damage taken by 5% for 2 turns and deals 5 DMG to all of them.
card_18_lore: Born in the depths of a bottomless lake, the Water Elemental is the embodiment of patience. It never hastens, never yields to panic. It knows that water always finds its way — and erodes whatever stands in its path.
card_18_quote: Water does not hurry. It always arrives.
card_19_skill1_desc: Brings down her blade of light on a target. Deals 12 DMG.
card_19_skill2_desc: Heals a target for 15% HP and reduces their damage taken by 5% for 2 turns. If HP is below 30%, grants them a Heal over Time of 5% for 2 turns.
card_19_lore: Lyoness left Liotnar the day she understood that light does not belong to a city — it belongs to all who need it. Since then, she wanders from kingdom to kingdom, offering her blade and her protection to those who deserve it. She has no master. She has a cause.
card_19_quote: Light does not ask for permission.
card_20_skill1_desc: Deals 8 DMG to a target and stuns them for 1 turn.
card_20_skill2_desc: Deals 10 DMG to all enemy cards. They lose 5% of max HP per turn for 2 turns.
card_20_lore: Adala never learned magic. She stole it from the storm. As a child, she survived a direct lightning strike in the Keth forest — since then, lightning obeys her. Other shamans call her unpredictable. She prefers uncontrollable.
card_20_quote: Lightning never misses the same target twice.
card_21_skill1_desc: Deals 6 DMG to a target and reduces a random ally's cooldown by 1 turn.
card_21_skill2_desc: Deals 12 DMG to a target and 60% to adjacent cards. Ignores Armor on all targets.
card_21_lore: The fishermen of the Arvel coast know Globmog's story well. Every storm that destroys the docks, every sunken boat, every overturned lighthouse: that's him. He has no particular motivation. He just hates whatever is dry.
card_22_skill1_desc: Deals 35 DMG to a target. If this card is below 40% HP, deals 15% additional damage.
card_22_skill2_desc: +20% attack to all allies for 2 turns and reduces their next cooldown by 1 turn.
card_22_passive_desc: When Djormund destroys an enemy card, it permanently gains 5% bonus damage and 10 Armor.
card_22_lore: Djormund survived the destruction of his clan, his kingdom, and his world. With each loss, he grew stronger. Not through magic — through refusal. He refuses to die before avenging every one of those he has lost. The universe still owes him much.
card_22_quote: They all fell before me. I am their testimony.
card_23_skill1_desc: Deals 8 DMG to a target and increases all their active cooldowns by 1 turn.
card_23_skill2_desc: Gains 15 Armor and grants 5 Armor to adjacent allies.
card_23_lore: No one created the Massif Golem — it has existed as long as the mountains have. It does not speak, does not think, obeys no one. It walks. And when it stops, it is because there is nothing left before it.
card_24_skill1_desc: Deals 12 DMG. The target loses 5% of max HP per turn for 2 turns.
card_24_skill2_desc: Deals 20 DMG and heals for 30% of damage dealt. Also heals a random ally for 10% of their max HP.
card_24_lore: The Blood Mage has no name. He had a name, once, but he sacrificed it as he sacrificed everything else — to gain the power to manipulate life itself. He does not fight to win. He fights to feed.
card_24_quote: Your blood is more useful in me than in you.
card_25_skill1_desc: Deals 14 DMG to a target. If the target is already Burning, increases damage dealt by 50%.
card_25_skill2_desc: Deals 18 DMG to a target and 50% to adjacent cards. Applies Burn (10% max HP) for 2 turns.
card_25_lore: No one really knows where this goblin comes from. He appeared one day in a burning village, laughing hysterically amid the flames. He runs from one battlefield to the next — not out of conviction, but because fires amuse him. No use giving him orders; he'll do what he wants anyway.
card_26_skill1_desc: Deals 30 DMG to a target and blocks all healing received for 2 turns.
card_26_skill2_desc: Deals 45 DMG to a target and 60% to adjacent cards. If the main target is below 20% HP, deals +20% damage.
card_26_passive_desc: For each card destroyed (ally or enemy), applies 5% max HP damage next turn to ALL cards in play, and increases Eldrich's damage dealt by 5%. (Stacks up to 5 times)
card_26_lore: Eldrich did not learn magic — he understood it. He spent his life studying the space between elements, where no mage had ever looked. What he found in those interstices changed his form, his nature, and his definition of what is possible. Today he is as much an idea as a being.
card_26_quote: The elements are words. I speak the whole language.
card_27_skill1_desc: Deals 30 DMG to a target. Renders them unable to be healed for 1 turn.
card_27_skill2_desc: +20 Armor to all allies. Reduces their damage taken by 10% for 2 turns.
card_27_passive_desc: For each Light ally destroyed in combat, grants +5% damage to all surviving allies.
card_27_lore: Arthurios has defended Liotnar against three invasions, two natural disasters, and a god. He has never taken a step back. Not out of pride — by choice. He knows that the day he retreats, someone behind him will retreat too. And that someone may be the last line of defense.
card_27_quote: Liotnar does not fall. Not while I stand.
card_28_skill1_desc: Deals 18 DMG to a target and heals all allies for 2% of their max HP.
card_28_skill2_desc: +10 Armor to all allied cards. Reduces their damage taken by 10% for 2 turns.
card_28_lore: The Knight of Liotnar does not fight for glory. He fights because he made an oath — and knights of Liotnar do not break their oaths. Even in the face of death. Especially in the face of death.
card_28_quote: My shield holds. Even when my legs no longer do.
card_29_skill1_desc: Deals 8 DMG to a target and reduces their damage dealt by 5% for 1 turn.
card_29_skill2_desc: Grants an ally +5 Armor and reduces their damage taken by 15% for 2 turns.
card_29_lore: He has no battle name yet. No scars yet. No legends yet. But he has something many warriors have lost through fighting: the conviction that it is worth it. The Squire of Liotnar is not the strongest on this field. He may be the last standing, precisely because he does not yet know he should be afraid.
card_29_quote: I'm not ready. But I'm here.
card_30_skill1_desc: Reduces an allied card's cooldown by 2 turns and grants them 1 bonus action.
card_30_skill2_desc: Increases an enemy card's cooldown by 1 turn. Deals 9 DMG.
card_30_passive_desc: If you have 5 or more Air stacks, reduces all allies' damage taken by 10% and increases all enemies' damage taken by 5%.
card_30_lore: Adelia is a Wind Sorceress. From a young age, she displayed exceptional talent in mastering the Wind, to the point where many farmers and Aurore soldiers sought her help.
card_30_quote: Beyond nature, I command the winds.
tuto_text_goal:
Destroy all of your opponent's cards to win the match.
Each player starts with 5 fixed cards on the board.
tuto_text_turn:
You have 2 actions per turn. Each action lets you use a skill from one of your cards.
You must end your turn manually. A 2-minute timer applies — if time runs out, the turn passes automatically.
tuto_text_cards:
Click on one of your cards to view its skills. Each card has 2 skills and sometimes a unique passive ability (indicated by an icon in the bottom-right corner of the artwork).
Some skills have a cooldown: wait the indicated number of turns before using them again.
Click on an enemy card to inspect its skills (read-only).
tuto_text_skills:
Attack — deals damage to an enemy target.
Heal — restores HP to an allied target.
Buff — strengthens one or more allied cards.
Debuff — weakens one or more enemy cards.
Mixed — a combination of offensive and defensive effects.
tuto_text_elements:
7 elements: Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, Darkness and Astral (max 10 stacks each).
Each action generates stacks for your team.
Minor bonuses: active from the 1st stack, benefit all your cards.
Major bonuses: activate at 3 or 5 stacks for cards of the same element.
tuto_text_armor:
Armor is an additional HP pool (max 100).
Damage is applied to armor first, then to HP once armor is depleted.
Some skills pierce armor and directly attack HP.
tuto_text_passive:
Each card has a unique passive that triggers under specific conditions:
turn start, card destruction, stack threshold reached...
Inspect enemy cards to anticipate their passives.
codex_fire_fastdesc: The Fire element is the most brutal in the game. Their attacks are often very powerful, but in return, their Hit Points are lower than other elements. This makes them a potential danger if not eliminated quickly.
codex_fire_statsdesc:
Hit Points: Low
Damage Potential: High
Armor: None

Note: Generates critical hit damage bonuses | Great combo with the Air element.
codex_fire_stacksdesc:
The Fire path accumulates element "Stacks" to create powerful reactions:

Minor Stack: +3% DMG to all allied cards per stack (Max 5 Stacks)

Stack 3: DMG dealt by "Fire" cards now hits adjacent targets.

Stack 5: Fire cards gain +10% Critical Hit Damage and +5% Critical Strike Chances, and can apply adjacent damage with single-target skills.

Note: The Minor Stack is always active. Thresholds 3 and 5 are mutually exclusive — only the highest active threshold applies.
codex_water_fastdesc: The Water element is the game's buffer/debuffer. Its damage is low, but it can greatly hinder enemy cards or greatly boost allied cards. They can also stun enemy targets.
codex_water_statsdesc:
Hit Points: Moderate
Damage Potential: Low / Moderate
Armor: None

Note: "Water" cards can turn the tide of battle when used wisely.
codex_water_stacksdesc:
The Water path accumulates element "Stacks" to create powerful reactions:

Minor Stack: -2% damage taken by all allied cards per stack (Max 5 Stacks)

Stack 3: -5% damage dealt by all enemies.

Stack 5: -10% damage dealt by all enemies.

Note: The Minor Stack is always active. Thresholds 3 and 5 are mutually exclusive — only the highest active threshold applies.
codex_earth_fastdesc: The Earth element is the weakest of all. In return, it is an excellent buffer that grants allies armor, reducing their damage taken. It also has the highest maximum Hit Points, making these opponents difficult to eliminate in a swift strike.
codex_earth_statsdesc:
Hit Points: High
Damage Potential: Low
Armor: Variable

Note: Can also hinder enemies by stunning them.
codex_earth_stacksdesc:
The Earth path accumulates element "Stacks" to create powerful reactions:

Minor Stack: -2% damage taken by all allied cards per stack (Max 5 Stacks)

Stack 3: Grants +3 permanent armor to all allied cards.

Stack 5: Grants +5 permanent armor to all allied cards.

Note: The Minor Stack is always active. Thresholds 3 and 5 are mutually exclusive — only the highest active threshold applies.
codex_air_fastdesc: The Air element is the most versatile of all. It can deal good damage and grant excellent critical hit bonuses to allies. This element can also increase or reduce cooldowns.
codex_air_statsdesc:
Hit Points: Moderate
Damage Potential: Moderate
Armor: None

Note: When used well, "Air" cards can make battles swift.
codex_air_stacksdesc:
The Air path accumulates element "Stacks" to create powerful reactions:

Minor Stack: +2% critical hit chance to all allied cards per stack (Max 5 Stacks)

Stack 3: +5% critical hit damage to all allies.

Stack 5: +10% critical hit damage to all allies, and adds 5% critical hit chance.

Note: The Minor Stack is always active. Thresholds 3 and 5 are mutually exclusive — only the highest active threshold applies.
codex_dark_fastdesc: The Darkness element is an excellent choice for a solo playstyle. This element is based on life steal and stat theft (temporary or permanent), making it unpredictable.
codex_dark_statsdesc:
Hit Points: Moderate
Damage Potential: Moderate / High
Armor: None

Note: The healing bonus from Light cards can improve life steal heals. (Ironic, isn't it?)
codex_dark_stacksdesc:
The Darkness path accumulates element "Stacks" to create powerful reactions:

Minor Stack: +2% DMG per enemy card still alive per stack (Max 5 Stacks)

Stack 3: +5% life steal for Darkness cards.

Stack 5: +10% life steal for Darkness cards.

Note: The Minor Stack is always active. Thresholds 3 and 5 are mutually exclusive — only the highest active threshold applies.
codex_light_fastdesc: The Light element is an excellent choice for cards that apply healing, damage reduction, or minor armor bonuses.
codex_light_statsdesc:
Hit Points: Moderate
Damage Potential: Moderate / High
Armor: Rare

Note: Critical hits also apply to instant healing effects.
codex_light_stacksdesc:
The Light path accumulates element "Stacks" to create powerful reactions:

Minor Stack: +2% healing effectiveness per stack (Max 5 Stacks)

Stack 3: Regenerates 3% of max HP for all allies per turn.

Stack 5: Regenerates 7% of max HP for all allies per turn.

Note: The Minor Stack is always active. Thresholds 3 and 5 are mutually exclusive — only the highest active threshold applies.
codex_corrosif_fastdesc: The Corrosive element is a brand new element. Its purpose is to reduce enemy armor and also reduce their maximum HP temporarily or permanently. Dangerous opponents when in large numbers.
codex_corrosif_statsdesc:
Hit Points: Moderate
Damage Potential: Moderate
Armor: None

Note: This element cannot receive armor from any source.
codex_corrosif_stacksdesc:
The Corrosive path accumulates element "Stacks" to create powerful reactions:

Minor Stack: -1 Armor to all enemy cards per stack.

Stack 3: Reduces the Max HP of all enemy cards by 5% (permanent while stacks hold).

Stack 5: Reduces the Max HP of all enemy cards by 10% (permanent while stacks hold).

Note: The Minor Stack is always active. Thresholds 3 and 5 are mutually exclusive — only the highest active threshold applies.
codex_necrotic_fastdesc: The Necrotic element is a brand new element. Its purpose is to reduce healing received by enemy targets and inflict fixed damage over time (Necrosis) for X turns. Dangerous opponents when in large numbers.
codex_necrotic_statsdesc:
Hit Points: Moderate
Damage Potential: Moderate
Armor: None

Note: If an enemy card dies while under the Necrosis effect, it explodes and deals 5% of its Max HP to adjacent cards.
codex_necrotic_stacksdesc:
The Necrotic path accumulates element "Stacks" to create powerful reactions:

Minor Stack: +1 damage to Necrosis (damage over time) effects per Necrotic card in play, ally or enemy. Always active, no threshold required.

Stack 3: When an allied Necrotic card is destroyed in combat, 5% chance to revive with 10% of its Max HP instead of dying.

Stack 5: Same trigger, 10% chance to revive.

Note: Thresholds 3 and 5 are mutually exclusive — only the highest active threshold applies.
codex_astral_fastdesc: The Astral element is the wildcard. It is a powerful element that can add a stack of the element directly to its left (card order 1→5). This allows for unique deck-building strategies.
codex_astral_statsdesc:
Hit Points: Moderate
Damage Potential: High
Armor: Rare

Note: This element can become extremely powerful when used well.

ui_raid_voragoth_desc: Sealed away for millennia, Voragoth awakens when the last seal breaks. Lord of the abyssal flames, he transcends his demonic form to become the God of the Last Eclipse, heralding the end of all life.

ui_raid_vaelthor_desc: They say Vaelthor never defeated death... he convinced it to serve him instead. As long as the two souls bound to his throne still breathe, no blade can reach him. But when the last guardian falls, the chains shatter and the King of Twin Bonds is reborn as a divine abomination feeding on the souls of the dead.
codex_states_fastdesc: In Astraleum, various status effects can be applied to cards, modifying the course of the battle — for better or worse.
codex_states_bleed: Bleed: Deals DMG over the duration indicated on the card.
codex_states_burn: Burn: Applies 5% Damage per turn, as defined by the skill.
codex_states_hot: Heal over Time: The card with this status recovers Hit Points over several turns.
codex_states_passive: Passive: A card with this status has a passive ability.
codex_states_channel: Channel: The card with this status is casting a skill that activates after 1 or 2 turns.
codex_states_healblock: Heal Block: A card with this status cannot receive healing while it is applied.
codex_states_poison: Poison: Deals DMG over time, ignores Armor.
codex_states_immortal: Immortal: This card cannot take any damage while this state is active.
codex_states_necrose: Necrosis: Deals fixed DMG per turn, stacks as independent instances.
keyword_dgt_desc: Damage dealt by the skill, before modifiers (elements, buffs, critical) are applied.
keyword_pv_desc: Remaining life of the card. A card is destroyed when its HP reaches 0.
keyword_heal_desc: Hit Points restored. Cannot exceed the card's Max HP, blocked by Heal Block.
keyword_arm_desc: Flat reduction of damage taken, applied before HP. Ignored by Poison, Bleed and Armor Piercing.
codex_link_fastdesc: In the game, beyond elemental affinities, certain cards will belong to factions, armies, or share attributes, linking them together. These affinities can provide minor bonuses between cards of the same faction, race, or group. This adds an extra strategic layer to deck-building.
codex_link_exampledesc:
Liotnar Knight + Liotnar Paladin + Liotnar Squire

→ Liotnar Passive: If multiple Liotnar cards are on the field, grants a +2 bonus to DMG dealt.

In this example, cards belonging to the Liotnar faction grant each other minor bonuses. Combined with other possible bonuses from elements and skills, you can create powerful synergies between elements and factions.
codex_link_importantdesc: In the current state, the affinity system is not yet available. Therefore, you cannot use this new game mechanic yet. But don't worry — it will be available soon! If you're here, you just found a little Easter egg for a future update!
